# AMES Food Advisory

> Food safety consulting, HACCP planning, training, auditing, and compliance readiness for food businesses across Sydney and NSW, Australia.

AMES Food Advisory is a Sydney-based food safety consultancy serving cafes, restaurants, food manufacturers, aged care facilities, childcare centres, food startups, and RTOs across New South Wales. Services include HACCP plan development, Food Safety Program (FSP) writing, on-site staff training, internal auditing, SOP documentation, commercial kitchen asset compliance, and end-to-end start-up compliance packages.

The principal consultant holds a Lead Auditor Statement of Attainment (SAI Global), is TAE-qualified (Certificate IV in Training & Assessment), and is a current TAFE NSW sessional lecturer in Food Science & Technology with 11+ years of national food manufacturing Quality Assurance experience.

## Core Services

- [HACCP Consultant Sydney](/food-safety-consulting-sydney): HACCP plan development, food safety program design, hazard analysis, food regulatory compliance consulting, food hygiene consulting, food business advisory, and warehouse/storage compliance. Fixed-price programs.
- [Internal Audit Service Sydney](/internal-auditing-services): Pre-inspection mock audits, gap analysis, document review, corrective action planning, compliance readiness support for NSW Food Authority and council inspections.
- [Food Safety Training Sydney](/food-safety-training-sydney): On-site food safety training — HACCP for supervisors, allergen management, GMP, food handler competency, record keeping. Delivered by a TAE-qualified trainer.
- [Food Safety SOP Writing](/sop-writing-food-businesses): Custom standard operating procedures, monitoring forms, allergen registers, cleaning schedules, corrective action records. Audit-ready documentation built for your specific operation.
- [Food Business Start-Up Package](/food-business-startup-package): Complete compliance setup for new food businesses — council registration guidance, custom food safety plan, SOPs, staff training, pre-audit walkthrough, 90-day post-launch support.
- [Commercial Kitchen Asset Compliance](/commercial-kitchen-asset-compliance): AS 4674 compliance audits, structural and equipment verification, ventilation and plumbing checks, written compliance reports with prioritised corrective actions.
- [Food Manufacturing Consultant](/food-manufacturer-consulting): HACCP for manufacturers, QA documentation, SQF gap analysis, regulatory compliance for food production facilities.
- [Food Lab Skills Training](/lab-skills-training): Practical food laboratory training — microbiological, chemical, sensory and physical testing techniques for QA teams and food industry workers.
- [RTO Resource Development](/rto-resource-development): Food safety training resources, assessment tools and learning materials for registered training organisations.
- [Sampling & Inspection Services](/sampling-inspection-services): Food sampling, product inspection and quality verification services.

- [Aged Care Food Safety NSW](/aged-care-food-safety-nsw): Class 1 food safety compliance for aged care facilities and hospitals.
